description: This file defines the Zend_Validate class in the Zend Framework, implementing the Zend_Validate_Interface. It provides validation capabilities by managing a chain of validator objects, executing validation, and retrieving validation messages and error codes. It also includes utility methods for managing default namespaces, class instantiation, and translation settings.

classes.name: Zend_Validate
classes.description: A class providing a chain-based validation mechanism, managing validators, executing validation, and handling validation messages, errors, namespace management, and dynamic class instantiation based on class names.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the chain with an optional flag to break the chain on failure.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Runs all validators in the chain against a given value, returning true if all pass.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Returns validation failure messages accumulated during validation.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns validation failure message codes; deprecated method.

methods.name: getDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Retrieves the currently set default namespaces for validation classes.

methods.name: setDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Sets the default namespaces for validation.

methods.name: addDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Adds new namespaces to the current default namespaces.

methods.name: hasDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Checks if default namespaces are set.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Dynamically instantiates and uses a validator class based on class base name and optional namespaces, validating a value.
